description: An assisted form draft artifact for a procedure (ADR-2605312030 §3, `toritsugi_draft`). toritsugi ASSISTS the member in filling the 様式/フォーム; the member reviews + owns + (default) submits it themselves. CONSTITUTIONAL: this is input-assistance, NOT 官公署提出書類の作成代理 reserved to 行政書士/弁護士/税理士 (G5); the member always confirms before any submission (G8); the draft's PII content lives ONLY in an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* DID-bound envelope (G6) — this record holds the POINTER + metadata, never inline PII.

memberDid.description: The member who owns the draft (申請者本人, G3/G4)

guideRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the parent procedureGuide session

encryptedDraftRef.description: Pointer to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding the filled draft (G6); never inline PII

assistMode.description: Always input-assist — never 作成代理 (G5). A schema-level invariant: no other value is representable.

memberConfirmed.description: G8 — the member has reviewed + confirmed the draft content before it may be submitted
